title: Shell analysis from input surfaces or meshes
description_for_llm: Linear elastic (Theory I) shell analysis of a meshed surface. Use for slabs, plates and simple shells. Assumptions: geometry in metres (meshes bound directly; breps/surfaces are meshed by the runner), constant shell cross-section per the template, self weight active, ALMOND_IN_LOAD_KNM2 drives the template's Unit-Z area load vector, supports at ALMOND_IN_SUPPORTS. CAVEAT for flat horizontal plates: the validator's automatic lowest-Z supports would pin EVERY node of a flat plate and trivially zero the deflection - pass explicit column/wall support points for a meaningful check. Limits: no per-element utilization output; no buckling. HARNESSED 2026-08-30 from 01_InputSurfacesAsShell.ghx (the input-surfaces Karamba example, not the slider-parametric 02_SimpleShell). Verified 2026-08-30: 6x6 m plate (4x4 mesh, 4 corner supports, fully fixed) sags 28.9 mm under self-weight, 53.3 mm at factor -5; the Karamba TRIAL version caps shell elements (a 12x12 mesh already exceeds it), so keep test meshes at or below ~5x5 faces on a trial license. Support DOFs are set fully fixed in the harness to suppress the flat-shell drilling rigid-body mode.

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_MESH
inputs.description: Shell mesh (or brep/surface - the runner meshes it) in metres.

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_LOAD_KNM2
inputs.description: SIGNED Unit-Z load factor added to self-weight: NEGATIVE acts downward (with gravity) - pass e.g. -5 for a 5 kN/m2 gravity-direction live load. The validator's template pathway passes load_kn as a positive number, which acts upward and REDUCES computed deflection, so template shell verdicts lean on the self-weight baseline; for load-critical flat plates call run_gh_definition directly with a negative factor.

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_SUPPORTS
inputs.description: Support node positions (columns/walls). Strongly recommended for flat plates - see capsule description.

outputs.name: ALMOND_OUT_DISP_MM
outputs.description: Largest nodal displacement; Karamba's Analyse emits centimetres, converted downstream per these units.

outputs.name: ALMOND_OUT_MASS_KG
outputs.description: Total structural mass of the model.
